knowledge:
- key_parameters: alignment.inputfile=Path to the BAM or BED alignment file containing CIGAR information ;; umi.inputfile=Path to the tab-delimited file containing read IDs and their corresponding UMIs ;; gRNA.file=Path to the FASTA file containing the guide RNA sequence ;; BSgenomeName=A BSgenome object of the organism of interest (e.g., Hsapiens) ;; min.reads=Minimum number of reads required to call a peak ;; n.cores.max=Maximum number of cores to use for parallel processing ;; upstream=Distance in base pairs to extend upstream of the peak region for off-target analysis ;; downstream=Distance in base pairs to extend downstream of the peak region for off-target analysis ;; PAM.size=Size of the PAM sequence ;; gRNA.size=Size of the gRNA sequence ;; PAM=PAM sequence of interest (e.g., NGG) ;; PAM.pattern=Regular expression pattern for PAM matching ;; max.mismatch=Maximum number of mismatches allowed for off-target identification ;; orderOfftargetsBy=Criteria to sort off-targets (e.g., "predicted_cleavage_score" or "peak_score")
- alternatives: GS-Preprocess (an external 6-argument pipeline) can be used to preprocess raw BCL files into the required BAM/BED and UMI files before running GUIDEseq. CRISPRseek is used internally for off-target homology scoring, and ChIPpeakAnno is used internally for peak merging.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have performed a GUIDE-seq experiment to profile genome-wide off-target cleavage sites of CRISPR-Cas nucleases and have obtained alignment files (BAM/BED) and UMI files.
- pitfalls: Ensure that R1 reads are used as input to the getUmi.pl script when generating the UMI file. The alignment file must contain CIGAR information; if using BED format, it must be tab-delimited and contain chromosome, start, end, readID, mapping quality, strand, and CIGAR columns.

workflows.name: step_by_step_guideseq
workflows.intent: Perform GUIDE-seq analysis step-by-step to remove PCR bias, identify peaks, merge strands, and analyze off-targets.
input: bowtie2.HEK293_site4_chr13.sort.bam (BAM alignment file with CIGAR info)
UMI-HEK293_site4_chr13.txt (tab-delimited file with read IDs and UMIs)
T2.fa (FASTA file of the gRNA sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Remove PCR bias and obtain unique cleavage events using getUniqueCleavageEvents ;; 2. Summarize cleavage events into peaks using getPeaks ;; 3. Merge peaks from plus and minus strands using mergePlusMinusPeaks ;; 4. Perform off-target analysis of extended regions around identified cleavage sites using offTargetAnalysisOfPeakRegions
workflows.code:
uniqueCleavageEvents <- getUniqueCleavageEvents(bamfile, umifile, n.cores.max =1)
uniqueCleavageEvents$cleavage.gr
peaks <- getPeaks(uniqueCleavageEvents$cleavage.gr, min.reads = 80)
peaks.gr <- peaks$peaks
peaks.gr
mergedPeaks <- mergePlusMinusPeaks(peaks.gr = peaks.gr,  
    output.bedfile = "mergedPeaks.bed")
mergedPeaks$mergedPeaks.gr
head(mergedPeaks$mergedPeaks.bed)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
peaks <- system.file("extdata", "T2plus100OffTargets.bed",
    package = "CRISPRseek")
gRNAs <- system.file("extdata", "T2.fa",
    package = "CRISPRseek")
outputDir <- getwd() 
offTargets <- offTargetAnalysisOfPeakRegions(gRNA = gRNAs, peaks = peaks,
    format=c("fasta", "bed"),
    peaks.withHeader = TRUE, BSgenomeName = Hsapiens,
    upstream = 50, downstream =50, PAM.size = 3, gRNA.size = 20,
    PAM = "NGG", PAM.pattern = "(NAG|NGG|NGA)$", max.mismatch = 2,
    outputDir = outputDir,
    orderOfftargetsBy = "predicted_cleavage_score",
    allowed.mismatch.PAM = 2, overwrite = TRUE
   )

workflows.name: all_in_one_guideseq
workflows.intent: Run the entire GUIDE-seq analysis workflow (from UMI deduplication to off-target analysis) in a single function call.
input: bowtie2.HEK293_site4_chr13.sort.bam (BAM alignment file with CIGAR info)
UMI-HEK293_site4_chr13.txt (tab-delimited file with read IDs and UMIs)
gRNA.fa (FASTA file of the gRNA sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Run the complete pipeline using GUIDEseqAnalysis
workflows.code:
gRNA.file <- system.file("extdata","gRNA.fa", package = "GUIDEseq")
system.time(guideSeqRes <- GUIDEseqAnalysis(
    alignment.inputfile = bamfile, 
    umi.inputfile = umifile, gRNA.file = gRNA.file, 
    orderOfftargetsBy = "peak_score",
    descending = TRUE, n.cores.max = 1,
    BSgenomeName = Hsapiens, min.reads = 1))
names(guideSeqRes)
